verdict.rationale: The product's core interaction is natural language. The user types a goal such as "Open Settings and go to Wi-Fi" and presses Start, and the AI agent then operates the iPhone on its own, as in the Clock alarm example. Saved tasks can also be triggered from Siri, Shortcuts, widgets and Control Center. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration beyond the repo README; free-form spoken commands, since Siri only runs saved tasks rather than taking new goals.
